sceneLede.text: Station 3 of 5
Rejects stale or future-dated oracle reports, and halts when the oracle and the book disagree
Widens and shrinks size before the underlying market closes, flattens five minutes out, and ramps back in after the open
Hard caps on notional, daily loss and drawdown, plus a kill switch the agent cannot override
The AI only nudges risk parameters inside fixed bounds. It never predicts price or places an order, because a deterministic engine does all of the quoting
